title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings between discrete gravity and cosmology
abstract: This paper tests three operator-level ways for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) to couple a discrete-gravity prefactor to the linear growth of structure: multiplicative Geff on the Poisson source, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), an fσ8 compilation, and the EG statistic, it shows each class is either structurally excluded or fully degenerate with Ωm once geometry is locked, implying growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class.
